benefit_text: The scheme gives a registration certificate with 100 rupees on the NFDP platform. The scheme pays success fees of 3000 to 5000 rupees after bank loan disbursement. The scheme gives a one time insurance incentive and a performance grant.
who_can_apply: People and groups working in fisheries value chain can apply for registration on NFDP. Fish farmers with aquaculture farms up to 4hectares can apply for the insurance incentive. Micro and small enterprises working in fisheries can apply for the performance grant.
documents: People need Aadhar number linked with mobile and bank account details. People need loan disbursement certificate or loan account statement from the bank. People need aquaculture insurance policy papers and farm size details.
how_to_apply: People can apply online or through CSCs. People start new user registration on the NFDP home page. People need Aadhar number or PAN card number with linked mobile for OTP validation.
